name: Inscribed and Circumscribed Regular Polygons
desc: Compare regular polygons inscribed in and circumscribed about a circle. Explore exact side lengths, perimeter, area, apothem, height, interior and central angles, and their convergence as the number of sides increases.
shortDesc: Explore 3–100 sided regular polygons, exact circle geometry and animated comparisons.
learningObjectives: Derive side length, perimeter and area from R and n
Compare inscribed and circumscribed polygons with the same circle
Identify interior, exterior and central angles
Investigate convergence to the circumference and area of a circle
modelAssumptions: Ideal Euclidean geometry with perfectly regular polygons
A fixed shared circle centered at the origin
The circumcircle of the inner polygon and incircle of the outer polygon are identical
Height is measured vertically from the horizontal bottom edge in canonical orientation
